The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4d07ebe181b03157), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 8. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let fD be centered, root-invariant, finite-radius vectors on the (D + 1)-regular tree. Root invariance means that the vector itself is fixed by every rooted permutation of complete child subtrees, including their seed coordinates, at every vertex of its finite neighborhood. Suppose their occupation embeddings converge strongly to v at a fixed finite height and their expected top-generation occupations are bounded uniformly in D. Place the same rooted vector at the endpoints of an edge, calling the resulting vectors fD,i and fD,j. Then lim D→∞ √ D 2 ⟨fD,i, fD,j⟩ = E(v) := Re⟨v, Lv⟩. (2.6) For any centered v, w, |E(v) − E(w)| ≤ (∥v∥ + ∥w∥)∥v − w∥. (2.7)
